summary: 'Green Homes, Clean Futures' is a series of conservation workshops for homeowners that began September 15th, 2023, launched by local environmental groups and co-founders Janet Lewis and Michael Rodríguez. The workshops cover water saving, energy efficiency, composting and wildlife-friendly gardens, with hands-on activities, habit-formation advice, and a segment for kids. The program relies on local businesses, volunteers, and government partnership, and aims to spread sustainable practices from homes to neighborhoods.
one_line: Local 'Green Homes, Clean Futures' workshops, starting September 15th, 2023, teach homeowners hands-on sustainability skills with community, business, and city support.
key_facts: The 'Green Homes, Clean Futures' workshop series for homeowners started on September 15th, 2023.
Janet Lewis and Michael Rodríguez started the initiative after observing a similar successful concept in a neighboring city.
Michael Rodríguez is an environmental engineer who co-leads the workshops.
Topics include water-saving techniques, energy efficiency, composting, and creating wildlife-friendly gardens.
Hands-on activities include creating rain gardens, building solar-powered chargers, and installing a low-flow faucet.
Dr. Anna Kim, a behavioral scientist and guest speaker, stresses integrating environmentally-friendly habits into daily routines.
Local businesses contribute sustainable materials and tools, and environmental professionals volunteer as guest speakers.
Mayor Elena Vásquez attended the first workshop session and said the city is proud to be a partner.
The workshops united local government officials, eco-friendly businesses, and environmental NGOs.
Lucy Chen, the program's youth coordinator, oversees a special segment for kids with separate activities and educational materials.
Additional workshops are scheduled through the end of the year, and attendance has been growing with each event according to Lewis.
Dates and enrollment information are on the program's official website, and spots are limited.
